description:
Rooney Auctioneers are delighted to present Dursey, North Circular Road, Limerick to the market – an impressive and beautifully maintained 4 bedroom semi-detached residence with large attic room occupying one of Limerick's most prestigious and established residential addresses.

Situated on the highly sought-after North Circular Road & surrouded by mature trees  this exceptional home enjoys an unrivalled location within walking distance of Limerick City Centre, Villiers School, TUS, the University Hospital Limerick campus, Ted Russell Park and a wealth of local amenities, making it an ideal family home.

Upon entering, a welcoming entrance hall with attractive light timber flooring provides access to all reception rooms. The ground floor comprises a spacious living room featuring a solid fuel stove and bright south-facing double doors opening onto the rear garden, creating a warm and inviting living space. The light-filled kitchen/ diningroom benefit from a desirable southerly aspect, with large windows, a skylight and a rear door allowing natural light to flood the room throughout the day and providng access to the rear deck area. The kitchen/diningroom also provides direct access to the attached garage, offering excellent storage together with convenient front and rear access. 
A ground floor bedroom and guest WC complete the accommodation on this level.

Upstairs, the first floor comprises three bright generously proportioned bedrooms together with the main family bathroom. A striking wrought iron spiral staircase leads to a versatile second-floor attic room, featuring a south-facing skylight, extensive storage and an attractive space offering endless potential as a home office, studio, hobby room 
or additional accommodation, subject to the purchaser's requirements.

Throughout the property, a wealth of beautiful original features has been carefully preserved, including original timber doors and flooring, adding warmth, character and timeless appeal. These charming period details are complemented by tasteful modern upgrades, including stylish retrofitted radiators throughout the home.

The family bathroom features an elegant heritage-style radiator with an integrated heated towel rail, perfectly complementing the property's character.
Further enhancing the home's efficiency is a modern combi boiler with a two-zone heating system, providing instant hot water and economical day-to-day running costs while eliminating the need for an immersion heater.

The property also benefits from the availability of full architectural drawings for further proposed renovations, should the new owner wish to extend or reconfigure the accommodation. This provides excellent potential for future enhancement and added value, subject to the necessary planning permissions.

Dursey presents a rare opportunity to acquire a character-filled family home combining period elegance with modern convenience in one of Limerick's fines residential locations

Early viewing is highly recommended.
